action.description: Action to perform. Prefer explicit values like 'send', 'react', or 'upload-file'.

channel.description: The channel to send the message to (e.g., 'telegram')

chat_id.description: The chat/conversation ID to reply to (usually from the channel-notification attributes). Use this for replies in the current routed chat. For WhatsApp proactive sends, use the full WhatsApp JID here (for example '584149145006@s.whatsapp.net') and pass accountId.

target.description: Explicit outbound target for proactive sends on supported channels (for example, a Slack channel like '#general' or 'channel:C12345678', or a Slack user DM like 'user:U12345678'). Do not use target for WhatsApp; use chat_id with the WhatsApp JID instead.

accountId.description: Optional channel account identifier when multiple eligible channel accounts are available for proactive sends.

replyTo.description: Optional message ID to reply to. Omit unless you intentionally want the platform's quote/reply UI.

threadId.description: Optional thread identifier override for threaded channels.

messageId.description: Target message ID for actions like react.

remove.description: Set to true to remove the reaction instead of adding it.

media.description: Required absolute local file path for action='upload-file'.

filename.description: Optional uploaded filename override for media attachments

title.description: Optional uploaded title override for media attachments
